message.content:
Fix all ESLint errors in the following files. The main issues are:

1. `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` - Replace `any` with proper types or `unknown`
2. `@typescript-eslint/prefer-nullish-coalescing` - Replace `||` with `??` for nullable values
3. `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports` - Use `import type` for type-only imports
4. `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-definitions` - Use `type` instead of `interface`
5. `@typescript-eslint/member-ordering` - Reorder class members (public before private)
6. `no-await-in-loop` - Use Promise.all instead of await in loops
7. `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` - Remove or prefix with underscore
8. `@typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment` - Use @ts-expect-error instead of @ts-ignore
9. `@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports` - Use ES6 imports
10. `no-case-declarations` - Wrap case blocks in braces
11. `no-console` - Use console.debug instead of console.log/console.error
12. `@typescript-eslint/no-empty-function` - Add comment or remove empty functions
13. `@typescript-eslint/no-inferrable-types` - Remove explicit types that can be inferred
14. `@typescript-eslint/promise-function-async` - Add async to functions returning promises
15. `@typescript-eslint/prefer-readonly` - Mark properties as readonly

Files to fix (in src/ and __tests__/):
- __tests__/features/map/hooks/useTravelTime.test.ts (lines 111, 156, 192, 234, 281, 306, 377)
- __tests__/lib/services/dpe/client.test.ts
- __tests__/lib/services/dpe/index.test.ts
- __tests__/lib/services/dpe/utils.test.ts
- __tests__/lib/services/favorites/enrichment.test.ts
- __tests__/lib/services/isochrone.test.ts
- src/app/api/favorites/enrich-dpe/route.ts
- src/components/energy/dpe-card.tsx
- src/components/ui/toaster.tsx
- src/features/favorites/favorite-card.tsx
- src/hooks/use-dpe.ts
- src/hooks/use-toast.ts
- src/lib/actions/favorites/enrichment.action.ts
- src/lib/services/dpe/client.ts
- src/lib/services/dpe/index.ts
- src/lib/services/dpe/types.ts
- src/lib/services/dpe/utils.ts
- src/lib/services/favorites/enrichment.ts

For tests files with `any` types:
- Use proper mocking types or cast to the expected type using `as` keyword
- For mock implementations, you can use `as unknown as ExpectedType`

Run `pnpm lint` after fixing to verify the fixes work.
